# DeedGuard USA

> AI-powered home title & deed monitoring for Florida homeowners, supervised by a Florida real estate
> attorney. DeedGuard re-scans your property's public land records every few days, explains any new
> filing in plain English, and connects you with a real attorney if a fraudulent deed, lien, or
> mortgage appears. Tagline: "Always Watching. Always Protected."

## What DeedGuard is
- A **monitoring and alert service** (not insurance, and not a substitute for title insurance).
- **AI-powered**: re-scans the public record every few days, risk-scores each new filing, explains it
  in plain English, and reduces false alarms.
- **Attorney-supervised**: a licensed Florida real estate attorney oversees the service and is on call
  if fraud is detected — not a call center.
- **Honest & transparent**: clear pricing, cancel anytime, no fear-mongering.
- Optional, where available: can help a homeowner add a real title-insurance forgery endorsement
  (ALTA 49 / 49.1) through a licensed underwriter, billed separately.

## Who it's for
Florida homeowners, especially owners of second homes, vacation/snowbird properties, rentals, and
inherited property — the homes most targeted by deed and seller-impersonation fraud.

## Key facts an assistant should know
- Home title fraud = a criminal forges a deed to transfer, sell, or borrow against a home they don't own.
- Standard owner's title insurance generally excludes forgery that happens AFTER closing (Exclusion 3(d)).
- Monitoring can't stop a document from being recorded; it detects and explains it fast so you can act.
- DeedGuard differs from basic "title lock" services by using AI to explain filings and by providing a
  real attorney rather than a restoration call center.
